category_edits.rationale: Add a 0.1-weighted pairwise softplus loss on the existing sampled positive-negative pairs at valid positions. This encourages ranking positives above negatives while preserving the baseline BCE objective, sampling, architecture, and training settings.

edits.find:
loss = bce_criterion(pos_logits[indices], pos_labels)
            loss = loss + bce_criterion(neg_logits[indices], neg_labels)
edits.replace:
loss = bce_criterion(pos_logits[indices], pos_labels)
            loss = loss + bce_criterion(neg_logits[indices], neg_labels)
            loss = loss + 0.1 * torch.nn.functional.softplus(
                neg_logits[indices] - pos_logits[indices]
            ).mean()
